title: Zittau
description: A town at the point where Germany, Poland and the Czech Republic meet, with a university of applied sciences and low living costs.
html:
Three countries within walking distance

Zittau lies in the far south-east of Saxony, where the German, Polish and Czech borders meet. The old town, with its merchants' houses and two rare Lenten veils in its museums, reflects a prosperous past in the cloth trade. Today it is a quiet town of about 25,000 with the Zittau Mountains as its backyard.

Studying and working here

The local campus of a Saxon university of applied sciences offers engineering, energy technology, environmental science, business and social sciences, with international programmes that draw students from across Central and Eastern Europe. Living costs are among the lowest in Germany. Dresden is about an hour and a half away, and Prague not much further, which makes the location more connected than the map suggests.
